meta.title: Read your prescription
meta.description: Take a photo of your prescription and see each medicine, when to take it and what to watch for, in English, Urdu or Sindhi.

common.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes, especially with handwriting. Always confirm with your pharmacist or doctor.

privacy.intro: This page explains, in simple words, what happens to your prescription when you use this website. In short: your prescription is read by AI, it is not saved on our server, and anything you choose to keep stays on your own phone.

sections.title: 1. When you scan a prescription
points: Your photo is made smaller on your phone, then sent over a secure (encrypted) connection to our server.
Our server sends it to an AI service, Claude by Anthropic, only to read the prescription. The answer comes back to your phone.
Our server does not save your photo or what was read from it. They are used only for that one request and then forgotten.
We ask for your permission (the tick box) before your first scan.

sections.title: 2. Safety check and translation
points: To check your medicines for problems, we send only the medicine details, the patient's age, sex and weight, the diagnosis and any allergies written on the prescription.
To translate the summary, we send only the texts to be translated.
We never send the patient's or doctor's name, phone number or address for these checks.

sections.title: 3. About Anthropic (the AI company)
points: Anthropic processes the information for us to give you the result. Under its terms for business customers, it does not use this information to train its AI, and keeps it only for a limited time for safety checks.
Anthropic's servers may be outside Pakistan. You can read Anthropic's own privacy policy at anthropic.com/legal/privacy.

sections.title: 4. What is kept on your phone
points: Your settings (language, text size and so on) and that you gave permission.
Translations, so the same text isn't translated again.
My prescriptions: only prescriptions you choose to save (or all, if you turn on automatic saving).
You can delete them at any time: "Delete all" on My prescriptions, "Delete saved translations" in Settings, or by clearing this website's data in your browser.
Anyone who uses your phone can see what is saved. If you share your phone, delete them when you're done.

sections.title: 5. What our server keeps
points: No prescription photos, names, medicines or results.

To stop misuse, we count how many requests each visitor makes, using a scrambled form of your internet address that can't be turned back into the address. These counts delete themselves within 24 hours.
Short technical error notes (for example "the AI did not answer"), without any prescription details.
Our hosting company (Vercel) keeps standard visit records, such as internet address and time, under its own policy.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and tracking
points: We use one cookie, to remember your language.
There are no adverts, no tracking cookies and no visitor statistics tools on this website.
We never sell or share your information.

sections.title: 7. Children
points: For a child's prescription, a parent or guardian should do the scan.

sections.title: 8. Not medical advice
points: This website helps you understand your prescription. AI can make mistakes, especially with handwriting.
Always confirm with your pharmacist or doctor. Never stop or change a medicine without talking to them.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
points: If we change this policy, we will update it on this page and change the date at the top.

privacy.contactText: Call, send a WhatsApp message, or visit us. We can't see anything saved on your phone, but we're happy to help you delete it.
